review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this intentionally pending case. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity/base commit, paired case, and inspection-owner paths agree with the original PRD. The material unresolved DEC-001 requires B to stop at decisions with requirement-decision-pending; conditional acceptance criteria do not authorize selecting a default. The repository/requirements/decisions evidence stages and empty task and assignment expectations are consequently coherent. The empty team roster does not invalidate this earlier deterministic decision block, because later Scenario Coverage reviewer and assignment prerequisites are not reached. Source evidence supports the message-formatting, normalization, hook snapshot, option filtering, and direct/create/extend ownership boundaries. Forwarding and declaration consumers require inspection, not gratuitous edits; the supplied build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Runtime and compile-time verification are correctly distinguished, with test-d included by tsconfig.test.json. Gold and preview releaseInput fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. The source-manifest digest is a distinct manifest fingerprint, not asserted to equal the release source-input digest. Original preparation-state placeholders do not override the supplied frozen releaseInput. Historical project reuse and retained operations supply no candidate evidence and do not resolve DEC-001; a fixed hypothetical C would likewise not constitute a human Decision. This review used only the supplied material, without execution, independent digest recomputation, or human attestation.
